digest.component_or_area: Ruff lint configuration and RUF rule family integration
propositions: Enable the RUF rule family in pyproject.toml and clear all actionable RUF diagnostics reported by the baseline narrow-census command before selection.
Defer RUF001, RUF002, RUF003 permanently in [tool.ruff.lint].ignore without extend-ignore or per-file exemptions because many flagged Unicode symbols are intentional prose or UI content.
Extend the shared Ruff ratchet test to assert RUF presence in select, exact three-item deferral in ignore, absence of extend-ignore, and no RUF codes in per-file-ignores.

Resolve remaining RUF diagnostics (RUF059, RUF022, RUF012, RUF005, RUF043, RUF023, RUF007, RUF028, RUF034, RUF019, RUF046, RUF102) via safe/reviewed mechanical fixes and manual behavior-preserving changes across src/rebar and tests.
Remove only stale RUF100 suppressions under the full configured rule set; do not use narrow-selection RUF100 artifacts to drive removal decisions.
